notes:
BOSS: every buy hits the boss, every sell heals it; a daily ability written by the IMD swarm changes how much. Pair BOSS/IMD: every buy of BOSS is paid in IMD. Two fees on every trade: the pool's own LP fee of 1.25% (fee 12500, the only tier the mainnet hook policy admits) and, on top of it, the hook fee of 2.5% in IMD on all four swap shapes (1.5% pot, 1% treasury to the keeper wallet, which pays the swarm's daily jobs in IMD). Pot split on kill: 10% seed, then 50% killer / 50% by the damage each wallet still holds; credit follows the BOSS: BossToken reports every transfer to the hook (bound once by the hook's constructor, bindHook), a buy is credited to the wallet that receives the BOSS from the pool, BOSS handed back to the pool forfeits damage in proportion to the BOSS bought that round, BOSS sent to another wallet carries its credit. Payouts are pull-only (claimKill, claimDamage, claimTreasury). Abilities: STATICCALL, 50k gas, clamp [0.25x,4x], 1x fallback, swap reverts below the gas floor. Abilities are queued only with an IMD oracle EIP-712 answer (id*2+1) to a fixed question about AbilityBoard.pending(), then wait 12h; at most one activation per 24h. No owner, no setters, no proxy, no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT. Flags 0x20CC.

CONSTRUCTOR ARGS. All 9 are flat static values; only $poolManager and $token are filled by the factory. keeper = 0x656811F8b3FdddF9D7C94C7653103F73C61534c0: a dedicated keeper wallet written as a literal address on purpose (not $owner). It alone may propose abilities on the AbilityBoard and it collects the 1% treasury with claimTreasury; it cannot move the pot, touch claims or pause trading. board = 0x079Cfee2251a5cC3316e6eCD9621B71Af57E329B: the AbilityBoard already deployed on Ethereum mainnet with keeper() == 0x656811F8b3FdddF9D7C94C7653103F73C61534c0; the hook constructor reverts InvalidConfig unless the board has code and that keeper. signer = 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982: the IMD oracle attester. questionHash = 0x23f92186b6cdf23daa56a5420274a022f8cd0691f283f91fcd64d317749f132b: the hash IMD returns for the fixed ability question about this board (tools/oracle-check.mjs: panel 21, quorum 15, fixed window 26128900-26128901). Initial HP 500 IMD (500000000000000000000 wei). 129000 is |tick| of the launch price (2,500 IMD market cap, the policy's IMD opening cap). Panel 21 / quorum 15 are source constants (PANEL_SIZE, QUORUM) that match the oracle request.

POOL PIN. The last two constructor args (launch tick 129000, paired currency 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 = IMD) plus the source constants LP_FEE = 12500 and TICK_SPACING = 60 pin the pool key: beforeInitialize refuses any other paired currency (WrongPairedCurrency), fee (WrongLPFee) or tick spacing (WrongTickSpacing). LP_FEE and TICK_SPACING equal pool.fee and pool.tickSpacing; keep them.

INITIAL PRICE - ORDERING. pool.initialPrice is getSqrtPriceAtTick(-129000) = 125262255113908064987203232, right when BOSS sorts below IMD (currency0). If BOSS sorts above IMD the matching value is getSqrtPriceAtTick(129000) = 50111677533496076234078224273595. The hook accepts a start within 300 ticks of the launch tick for the ordering it sees (WrongStartingPrice otherwise); a 2,500 IMD cap over 1e9 BOSS is about tick -/+128,999, inside that tolerance in both orderings.

ATOMIC LAUNCH. The first valid initialize binds the hook to that pool, so the launch must deploy the hook and initialize the pool in one transaction sequence nobody can slip into.
